about_the_game:
You are an adventurer and have heard about a mysterious place that was discovered, but everyone who entered there never returned. All that is known is that the place is surrounded by mysteries, and strange things occur around it. All you know is that you are In Search of Something, but you don’t know exactly what it is. Will you be able to reach the end and discover what it is?

In Search of Something" is a platformer adventure game where you'll face various obstacles throughout each level. From pushing boxes to dodging fireballs, rolling boulders, and flying arrows, every challenge will put your skills to the test. In some areas, you might even encounter monsters!

Stay sharp, as some sections will require you to solve puzzles and uncover mysteries to move forward.

With a mix of exploration, adventure, and both simple and complex challenges, In Search of Something offers an exciting journey full of surprises!
